findings.text: The company was incorporated on 18 June 2019 and its status is recorded as active with a proposal to be struck off.
The accounts are overdue, with the next accounts due 31 December 2023 and the last accounts made up to 31 March 2022.
The confirmation statement is overdue, with the next statement due 29 July 2024 and the last statement made up to 15 July 2023.
No insolvency record is held for the company, and no charges are registered against it.
There is one current officer, a director, PERSON 076, appointed on 18 June 2019.
One current person with significant control is recorded: PERSON 077, an individual with ownership of shares of 75 to 100 percent.
No registered office address changes or officer appointments or resignations have been filed since 26 October 2025.
PERSON 076 has no other appointments on record, and no other companies were found through the current director, though this may be incomplete because appointments are matched by officer ID.

headline.text: TEST COMPANY 084 is active but has a proposal to be struck off the register, with overdue accounts and an overdue confirmation statement.
